line.aria-label: date: Dec 08, 2022; event_kind: considered_for_inclusion; Normalized state: CFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2022-12-08; Historical label: EIPs Considered for Inclusion (execution-specs cancun.md at creation); Normalization rationale: The execution-specs upgrade document's section name "EIPs Considered for Inclusion" maps directly to considered_for_inclusion. EIP-1153 was carried into the newly created Cancun upgrade spec from Shanghai's CFI list, which the same commit removed from shanghai.md; ACD call #151 minutes describe moving non-withdrawal candidates out of Shanghai. The prior Shanghai-era CFI status is a Shanghai fork relationship and is not modeled as a Cancun event.; Source: Update Shanghai and add Cancun (creates cancun.md upgrade spec); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/b11cdefd3db09986e44c8a641bf95be93362169b/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/b11cdefd3db09986e44c8a641bf95be93362169b/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md

date: Apr 27, 2023; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2023-04-27; Historical label: Included EIPs (execution-specs cancun.md); Normalization rationale: Moved from "EIPs Considered for Inclusion" to "Included EIPs" in cancun.md immediately after ACDE #160, where the decision was recorded ("we've been CFI-ing 1153 for quite a while and we moved it from Shanghai to Cancun... it would be fair to include it"). In the 2022-2023 process, "Included" in the upgrade spec meant client teams had agreed to ship the EIP in the still-unactivated upgrade, i.e. what later vocabulary calls Scheduled for Inclusion; "included" is reserved here for post-activation. ACDE #161 corroborates: "on the last call, we sort of agreed to include a bunch of EIPs. So at 1153...".; Source: Update Include and CFI'd EIPs (1153/6475/6780 to Included; 2537/4788/6493 CFI); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/ada4aa349eb8e4b01f1ca8ef95b26c8e055a6a44/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/ada4aa349eb8e4b01f1ca8ef95b26c8e055a6a44/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md

date: Jun 01, 2023; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2023-06-01; Historical label: features that we intend to build [down] into the Deneb spec (ACDC #110); Normalization rationale: The consensus-layer process used no CFI/SFI vocabulary; on ACDC #110 Danny Ryan fixed the list of features to build into the Deneb consensus spec ("4788, 6988, 7045, and this fixed voluntary exit domain... date: Apr 11, 2023; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-04-11T12:22:39+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Major redesign and revival ("Move to Draft"): retitles the EIP to "Beacon block root in the EVM"; switches from exposing the beacon state root via the ommers field to appending the parent beacon block's hash tree root as a new header field; renames the opcode to BEACON_ROOT keyed by slot with a SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT (8192) ring buffer; adds author Ansgar Dietrichs; updates discussions-to; status Stagnant -> Draft; removes the EIP-4399/EIP-3675 background references while keeping EIP-2935.; Classification rationale: Complete replacement of the exposed value (state root -> block root), commitment location (ommers -> header field), keying (block number -> slot), and storage bounding (unbounded -> ring buffer); all core normative behavior changed.; Confidence: high; Commit: a8cf4efb1e5fbc4fcf49788291cbfb1d098db23f; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a8cf4efb1e5fbc4fcf49788291cbfb1d098db23f; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/a8cf4efb1e5fbc4fcf49788291cbfb1d098db23f

date: May 17, 2023; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-05-17T22:23:54+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Send current slot from CL to avoid timestamp conversions": adds a second header extension (8-byte big-endian slot number) and rewrites block processing to read the last written slot from storage and iterate from start slot to end slot, writing the parent beacon block root into each ring-buffer slot.; Classification rationale: Changes the header schema and the storage-update algorithm; normative behavior.; Confidence: high; Commit: 14e48abc75d3a4345c43c8361c4fe5c00efefd95; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/14e48abc75d3a4345c43c8361c4fe5c00efefd95; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/14e48abc75d3a4345c43c8361c4fe5c00efefd95

date: May 24, 2023; value: 5; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-05-24T23:29:17+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Favor stateful precompile over opcode": removes the BEACON_ROOT opcode (OPCODE_VALUE deleted) in favor of a stateful precompile at HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS read via calldata; raises G_beacon_root from 20 to 2100; removes the EIP-2935 inspiration reference.; Classification rationale: Replaces the read interface mechanism (opcode -> precompile) and its gas cost.; Confidence: high; Commit: d810df00b8aa8f21741a93fd9391e703d69fcd37; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d810df00b8aa8f21741a93fd9391e703d69fcd37; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d810df00b8aa8f21741a93fd9391e703d69fcd37

date: May 31, 2023; value: 6; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-05-31T17:20:03+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Key beacon roots by root": drops the slot keying and SLOTS_PER_HISTORICAL_ROOT constant; storage is now keyed by the root itself with the header timestamp as value; removes the extra 8-byte slot header field (header extension reverts to the 32-byte root only); precompile queries by root and returns the timestamp.; Classification rationale: Changes storage layout, header schema, and precompile query semantics.; Confidence: high; Commit: f4c3a2f0b6ef4bbd218d86424539c42bf6a19ce0; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/f4c3a2f0b6ef4bbd218d86424539c42bf6a19ce0; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/f4c3a2f0b6ef4bbd218d86424539c42bf6a19ce0

date: Jun 12, 2023; value: 7; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-06-12T22:54:51+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS changed from 0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffd to Bytes20(0xB).; Classification rationale: Direct change to the precompile address constant.; Confidence: high; Commit: 6c7a38dc2b341a64f576a611e8466e135c722821; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/6c7a38dc2b341a64f576a611e8466e135c722821; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/6c7a38dc2b341a64f576a611e8466e135c722821

date: Jun 13, 2023; value: 7; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-06-13T20:11:07+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: "Clarify header and validity sections": replaces the numbered header-extension instruction with a sentence stating the header schema is extended with parent_beacon_block_root, and states validity is guaranteed from the consensus layer like withdrawals.; Classification rationale: Restates the same header-extension requirement more clearly; no requirement is added, removed, or altered.; Confidence: medium; Commit: d0f0942991069f556727c3920d3a49010c1b9ba0; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d0f0942991069f556727c3920d3a49010c1b9ba0; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d0f0942991069f556727c3920d3a49010c1b9ba0

date: Jul 05, 2023; value: 8; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-07-05T21:50:59+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Bound precompile storage": reintroduces bounded storage via two ring buffers (timestamp and root) sized by new constant HISTORICAL_ROOTS_MODULUS (98304); doubles G_beacon_root to 4200 (two SLOADs); adds the MUST requirement that execution clients verify the header root matches the value provided by the consensus client; specifies precompile input sanitization and zero-word return on timestamp mismatch; adds ring-buffer rationale sections.; Classification rationale: Changes storage bounding, gas, validation requirements, and read semantics.; Confidence: high; Commit: d05d4b3c3298613781a0804f851eb0201ca5a6c2; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d05d4b3c3298613781a0804f851eb0201ca5a6c2; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/d05d4b3c3298613781a0804f851eb0201ca5a6c2

date: Jul 07, 2023; value: 9; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-07-07T15:37:34+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Explicitly specify header schema": adds the full RLP encoding of the extended execution block header (27 lines), showing parent_beacon_block_root appended after data_gas_used/excess_data_gas.; Classification rationale: Makes the exact header data structure explicit; materially clarifies the interface implementers must produce.; Confidence: high; Commit: 43507321d19ef7aae5a03f3129d0b750e8e4b3ef; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/43507321d19ef7aae5a03f3129d0b750e8e4b3ef; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/43507321d19ef7aae5a03f3129d0b750e8e4b3ef

date: Aug 01, 2023; value: 10; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-08-01T12:58:43-07:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds the genesis edge case: for a genesis block with no existing parent beacon block root, 32 zero bytes are used as the root placeholder.; Classification rationale: Specifies previously undefined behavior for genesis blocks; affects implementations.; Confidence: high; Commit: 3ca51a1d26bd652dd9212b9b33ef3f74d6160d51; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/3ca51a1d26bd652dd9212b9b33ef3f74d6160d51; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/3ca51a1d26bd652dd9212b9b33ef3f74d6160d51

date: Aug 24, 2023; value: 11; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-08-24T14:07:04-07:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: "Initial stab at v2": replaces the stateful precompile with a regular deployed beacon roots contract; introduces SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe), BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS (0xbEac00dDB15f3B6d645C48263dC93862413A222D), and HISTORY_BUFFER_LENGTH (98304); specifies get/set dispatch by caller, exact contract bytecode, the synthetic keyless deployment transaction, and system-call semantics at the start of block processing (must execute to completion, not counted against block gas, does not follow EIP-1559 burn semantics, fails silently without code); adds authors Martin Holst Swende and lightclient; adds frontmatter requires: 1559.; Classification rationale: Wholesale redesign of the mechanism from precompile to system contract with new addresses, bytecode, deployment, and block-processing semantics.; Confidence: high; Commit: 46f8d5bc9593f096cd92f66692e115218ec1c633; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/46f8d5bc9593f096cd92f66692e115218ec1c633; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/46f8d5bc9593f096cd92f66692e115218ec1c633

line.aria-label: date: Dec 08, 2022; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2022-12-08; Historical label: Included EIPs (execution-specs cancun.md at creation); Normalization rationale: The Cancun upgrade spec was created with EIP-4844 as its sole "Included" EIP on the day of ACD call #151, whose written summary records: "We agreed that EIP-4844 should be included in the fork after Shanghai, to reflect how the CL specs are right now... for now I'll create cancun.md and list EIP-4844 as Included." In the 2022-2023 process, "Included" in the pre-activation upgrade spec meant client teams had committed to ship the EIP in the upgrade, i.e. what later vocabulary calls Scheduled for Inclusion. EIP-4844's earlier consideration for Shanghai (it appeared in shanghai.md's CFI list, removed by this same commit) is a Shanghai fork relationship and is not modeled as a Cancun event. Note: the minutes file header misdates the call to 2022-11-10; the agenda issue and matching YouTube link establish 2022-12-08 (see pm-issue-675).; Source: Update Shanghai and add Cancun (creates cancun.md upgrade spec); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/b11cdefd3db09986e44c8a641bf95be93362169b/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/b11cdefd3db09986e44c8a641bf95be93362169b/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md

date: Dec 08, 2022; value: 20; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2022-12-08; Historical label: Included EIPs (execution-specs cancun.md at creation); Normalization rationale: The Cancun upgrade spec was created with EIP-4844 as its sole "Included" EIP on the day of ACD call #151, whose written summary records: "We agreed that EIP-4844 should be included in the fork after Shanghai, to reflect how the CL specs are right now... for now I'll create cancun.md and list EIP-4844 as Included." In the 2022-2023 process, "Included" in the pre-activation upgrade spec meant client teams had committed to ship the EIP in the upgrade, i.e. what later vocabulary calls Scheduled for Inclusion. EIP-4844's earlier consideration for Shanghai (it appeared in shanghai.md's CFI list, removed by this same commit) is a Shanghai fork relationship and is not modeled as a Cancun event. So like 5920, 5656, and then the CALL... CFI"). The section name maps directly to considered_for_inclusion.; Source: Update cancun.md (5656/5920/7069 CFI; 6475 dropped from Included); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/e483185dde30f22049a8815eab72b324721eb925/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/e483185dde30f22049a8815eab72b324721eb925/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md

date: Jun 08, 2023; event_kind: scheduled_for_inclusion; Normalized state: SFI; Event role: State transition; Recorded at: 2023-06-08; Historical label: Included EIPs (execution-specs cancun.md); Normalization rationale: Moved from "EIPs Considered for Inclusion" to "Included EIPs" in cancun.md the same day as ACDE #163, where the decision was recorded: "we will add mcopy in, alongside 4788. If in a couple weeks we feel like mcopy is significantly slowing down things either from an implementation or testing perspective, we'll just kick it out. and we also will not add anything else to the fork." The commitment was explicitly conditional on implementation/testing progress, but it was a commitment to ship, normalized as scheduled_for_inclusion; no later removal occurred. "Included" in the pre-activation upgrade spec is normalized as scheduled_for_inclusion; "included" is reserved here for post-activation.; Source: Update included EIPs list (4788 and 5656 to Included; CFI section removed); Source URL: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/aa812f892c7f53917f40aca39eaf2dcbb057340a/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/aa812f892c7f53917f40aca39eaf2dcbb057340a/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/cancun.md

date: Apr 27, 2023; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-04-27T15:25:47+00:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a new '### Gas costs' subsection to the Specification stating that MCOPY belongs to the yellow-paper `W_copy` opcode group and giving the explicit formula: words_copied = (length + 31) // 32; g_verylow = 3; g_copy = 3 * words_copied + memory_expansion_cost; gas_cost = g_verylow + g_copy.; Classification rationale: Makes the gas schedule explicit with concrete constants and memory-expansion accounting, where the creation text only gave the symbolic `Gverylow + Gcopy * ceil(length / 32)`. Directly affects implementation and test expectations, so substantive.; Confidence: high; Commit: 241ba31d720106fd59b08e7bccfff73c1866428a; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/241ba31d720106fd59b08e7bccfff73c1866428a; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/241ba31d720106fd59b08e7bccfff73c1866428a

date: Apr 29, 2023; value: 1; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-04-29T00:35:09-07:00; Change type: editorial; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Typo/grammar fixes only: 'This instructions returns' -> 'This instruction returns'; 'as if an intermediate buffer were used' -> 'was used'; 'which did not exists previously' -> 'did not exist previously'.; Classification rationale: Grammar only; the overlapping-copy semantics, stack layout, and gas rules are unchanged in meaning.; Confidence: high; Commit: c2d1a0328e2e796199e05c0be3eb979d78cbc678; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/c2d1a0328e2e796199e05c0be3eb979d78cbc678; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/c2d1a0328e2e796199e05c0be3eb979d78cbc678

path.aria-label: date: Sep 10, 2023; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-09-09T20:35:59-07:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Rewrites the Specification bullets ('Add clarifications to EIP-6780'): states that the current execution frame halts, that SELFDESTRUCT deletes no data at all (storage keys, code, account) outside same-transaction creation, that Ether is no longer burnt when target == self for pre-existing contracts (but still burnt for same-transaction-created contracts), and adds a definition of when a contract is 'considered created' (start of a create transaction or when a CREATE-series operation begins execution, including when a balance already exists at the address). Also adds a counterfactual-account rationale paragraph, rewrites Backwards Compatibility, and fixes the mis-numbered Security Considerations list while adding the Ether-burn case.; Classification rationale: Changes and materially clarifies normative EVM behaviour (self-targeting burn semantics, frame halting, contract-creation definition) that implementers and testers must follow.; Confidence: high; Commit: 22c0ef2b2a9d5ab52705c21128f99a5e082013aa; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/22c0ef2b2a9d5ab52705c21128f99a5e082013aa; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/22c0ef2b2a9d5ab52705c21128f99a5e082013aa

date: Sep 28, 2023; value: 1; semantic_effect: non_substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-09-28T15:55:53+00:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: non_substantive; Summary: Removes the Specification note stating that, once verkle tries are implemented, cleared storage would be marked as written-before-but-empty and a created-and-deleted contract would yield a different state root (single-line deletion).; Classification rationale: Removes a forward-looking, non-normative note about hypothetical future verkle-trie behaviour; the normative pre-verkle SELFDESTRUCT rules are unchanged, so implementations and tests for this fork are unaffected. Judgement call: the deleted sentence sat inside the Specification section and described a state-root consequence, so a stricter reading could treat the deletion as substantive. Recorded as non_substantive with medium confidence and the ambiguity preserved in unknowns.; Confidence: medium; Commit: 9df2962cf2e743c3d22bf75c5efbe06bea1f7331; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/9df2962cf2e743c3d22bf75c5efbe06bea1f7331; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/9df2962cf2e743c3d22bf75c5efbe06bea1f7331

date: Nov 01, 2023; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-11-02T07:55:07+08:00; Change type: clarification; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Replaces 'caller' with 'target' as the recipient of the recovered funds in both the frontmatter description and the Abstract ('send all Ether in the account to the target').; Classification rationale: Corrects a factually wrong statement about where funds go. The normative Specification section already said 'transfers the entire account balance to the target', so no rule changed, but the Abstract/description previously contradicted it in a way that could mislead an implementer or test author; classified as a material clarification. path.aria-label: date: Sep 13, 2023; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2023-09-13T16:46:42+00:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: 'BLOBBASEFEE opcode' follow-up (ethereum/EIPs#7701). Adds the normative sentence "BLOBBASEFEE returns the result of the get_blob_gasprice(header) -> int function as defined in EIP-4844 Gas accounting", replaces the symbolic gas cost G_base with the literal 2 in the Specification and Rationale, restates the test case in terms of get_blob_gasprice(header), and fixes the discussions-to URL.; Classification rationale: Pins the returned value to a named EIP-4844 function instead of the informal phrase "the blob base-fee", which is what implementers and test writers must reproduce.; Confidence: high; Commit: ed54cdb1a790870df34ad71f55441f40d62813c3; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ed54cdb1a790870df34ad71f55441f40d62813c3; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ed54cdb1a790870df34ad71f55441f40d62813c3
